title: Knitting a Scarf for a Frog
altTitles: Tiny Knitting for a Cold Frog (Miniature ASMR)
description:
A frog shivers at the bakery door, so Bramble knits it a slate-grey scarf by the oven. It is a little too long. Wordless cozy miniature from Thimble Town.
